(
Dutch pronunciation:

ˈɦaːɲtɕə]
) is a
hamlet
in the
Dutch
province
of
North Brabant
. It is located in the
municipality
of
Steenbergen
, about 2 km west of
Kruisland
.
[
2
]
't Haantje is not a statistical entity,
[
3
]
and the postal authorities have placed it under
Steenbergen
.
[
1
]
It has no place name signs, and was named after the inn Het Hanengevecht. The hamlet consists of about 20 houses.
